verdict.rationale: Cooley GO's web-based document generators and data tools are products where telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an opt-out, cookie, or tracking control. The Cyber/Data/Privacy item describes the firm's legal advisory practice, not a product privacy setting, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
